# Every nation's youngest EURO appearance-maker and scorer
Tuesday, July 9, 2024
## Article summary
Who are the youngest players to have played and scored for the EURO 2024 contenders at a EURO finals?
## Article top media content
![Lamine Yamal is the youngest player ever to appear and score at a EURO ](https://editorial.uefa.com/resources/028f-1b546cac02ae-539d6a262833-1000/format/wide1/spain_v_croatia_group_b_-_uefa_euro_2024.jpeg?imwidth=158)
Lamine Yamal is the youngest player ever to appear and score at a EURO  UEFA via Getty Images
## Article body
Spain's Lamine Yamal is the [youngest player to appear at a UEFA EURO](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/news/0255-0d9f33ac425a-2e8c3765087b-1000--lamine-yamal-sets-new-record-as-youngest-player-to-feature-a/), taking to the pitch against Croatia on 15 June 2024 aged 16 years and 338 days.
Who are the youngest players to impress for all the EURO contenders?
### **Albania**
Youngest player: **Medon Berisha** , 20 years 247 days (vs Spain, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036164--italy-vs-albania/))  
Youngest scorer: **Armando Sadiku** , 25 years 23 days (vs Romania, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))
### **Austria**
Youngest player: **Leopold Querfeld** , 20 years 188 days (﻿vs Netherlands, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036192--netherlands-vs-austria/))  
Youngest scorer: **Christoph Baumgartner** , 21 years 324 days (vs Ukraine, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024451--england-vs-croatia/))
### **Belgium**
Youngest player: **Enzo Scifo** , 18 years 115 days (﻿vs Yugoslavia, [EURO '84](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1984/))  
Youngest scorer: **Emile Mpenza** , 21 years 342 days (vs Sweden, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))
![Belgium's Enzo Scifo at EURO '84](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Belgium's Enzo Scifo at EURO '84Icon Sport via Getty Images
### **Croatia**
Youngest player: **Ivan Rakitić** , 20 years 94 days (vs Germany, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))  
Youngest scorer: **Luka Modrić** , 22 years 273 days (vs Austria, [EURO 2008](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2008/))
### **Czechia**
Youngest player: **Adam Hložek** , 18 years 324 days (﻿vs Scotland, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024451--england-vs-croatia/))  
Youngest scorer: **Milan Baroš** , 22 years 231 days (vs Latvia, [EURO 2004](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2004/))
### **Denmark**
Youngest player: **Michael Laudrup** , 19 years 363 days (﻿vs France, [EURO '84](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1984/))   
Youngest scorer: **Mikkel Damsgaard** , 20 years 353 days (vs Russia, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024441--netherlands-vs-ukraine/))
![Denmark's Michael Laudrup at EURO '84](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Denmark's Michael Laudrup at EURO '84Icon Sport via Getty Images
### **England**
Youngest player: **Jude Bellingham** , 17 years 349 days (﻿vs Croatia, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024451--england-vs-croatia/))  
Youngest scorer: **Wayne Rooney** , 18 years 237 days (vs Switzerland, [EURO 2004](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2004/))
### **France**
Youngest player: **Kingsley Coman** , 19 years 363 days (﻿vs Romania, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Youngest scorer: **Bruno Bellone** , 22 years 105 days (vs Spain, [EURO '84](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1984/))
![France's Kingsley Coman against Romania at EURO 2016](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
France's Kingsley Coman against Romania at EURO 2016Getty Images
### **Georgia**
Youngest player: **Anzor Mekvabishvili** , 23 years 13 days (vs Türkiye, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036171--turkiye-vs-georgia/))   
Youngest scorer: **Khvicha Kvaratskhelia** , 23 years 135 days (vs Portugal, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036196--georgia-vs-portugal/)) 
### **Germany**
Youngest player: **Lukas Podolski** , 19 years 19 days (﻿vs Czech Republic, [EURO 2004](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2004/))  
Youngest scorer: **Florian Wirtz** , 21 years 42 days (vs Scotland, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036161--germany-vs-scotland/))
### **Hungary**
Youngest player: **Zoltán Varga** , 19 years 171 days (vs Spain, [EURO '64](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1964/))  
Youngest scorer: **Ferenc Bene** , 19 years 183 days (vs Spain, [EURO '64](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1964/))
### **Italy**
Youngest player: **Paolo Maldini** , 19 years 350 days (﻿vs West Germany, [EURO '88](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1988/))  
Youngest scorer: **Pietro Anastasi** , 20 years 64 days (vs Yugoslavia, [EURO '68](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1968/))
![Paolo Maldini \(left\) in action against West Germany at EURO '88](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Paolo Maldini (left) in action against West Germany at EURO '88Bob Thomas Sports Photography vi
### **Netherlands**
Youngest player: **Jetro Willems** , 18 years 71 days (﻿vs Denmark, [EURO 2012](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2012/))  
Youngest scorer: **Patrick Kluivert** , 19 years 353 days (vs England, [EURO '96](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1996/))
### **Poland**
Youngest player: ****Kacper Kozłowski**** , 17 years 246 days (vs Spain, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024451--england-vs-croatia/))  
Youngest scorer: **Arkadiusz Milik** , 22 years 105 days (vs Northern Ireland, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))
### **Portugal**

Youngest player: **Renato Sanches** , 18 years 301 days (﻿vs Iceland, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Youngest scorer: **Renato Sanches** , 18 years 317 days (vs Poland, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))
### **Romania**
Youngest player: **Gheorghe Hagi** , 19 years 130 days (vs Spain, [EURO '84](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1984/))  
Youngest scorer: **Cristian Chivu** , 19 years 238 days (vs England, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))
### **Scotland**
Youngest player: **Nathan Patterson** , 19 years 279 days (vs Croatia, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024451--england-vs-croatia/))  
Youngest scorer: **Gary McAllister** , 27 years 176 days (vs Commonwealth of Independent States, [EURO '92](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1992/))
### **Serbia**
Youngest player: **Dragan Stojković** , 19 years 102 days (vs Belgium, [EURO '84](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1984/))  
Youngest scorer: **Dragan Stojković** , 19 years 108 days (vs France, [EURO '84](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/1984/))
### **Slovakia**
Youngest player: **Leo Sauer** , 18 years 188 days (vs Ukraine, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036182--slovakia-vs-ukraine/))  
Youngest scorer: **Ondrej Duda** , 21 years 189 days (vs Wales, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))
![Ondrej Duda after scoring against Wales at EURO 2016](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Ondrej Duda after scoring against Wales at EURO 2016Getty Images
### **Slovenia**
Youngest player: **Benjamin Šeško** , 21 years 16 days: (vs Denmark, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036165--slovenia-vs-denmark/))   
Youngest scorer: **Miran Pavlin** , 28 years 249 days (vs Yugoslavia, [EURO 2000](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2000/))
### **Spain**
Youngest player: **Lamine Yamal** , 16 years 338 days (﻿vs Croatia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036163--spain-vs-croatia/))   
Youngest scorer: ****Lamine Yamal**** , 16 years 362 days (vs France, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036163--spain-vs-croatia/))
### **Switzerland**
Youngest player: **Johan Vonlanthen** , 18 years 137 days (﻿vs England, [EURO 2004](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2004/))  
Youngest scorer: **Johan Vonlanthen** , 18 years 141 days (vs France, [EURO 2004](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2004/))
![Johan Vonlanthen after scoring against France at EURO 2004](https://img.uefa.com/imgml/void.svg)
Johan Vonlanthen after scoring against France at EURO 2004AFP via Getty Images
### **Türkiye**
Youngest player: **Emre Mor** , 18 years 324 days (﻿vs Croatia, [EURO 2016](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro/history/seasons/2016/))  
Youngest scorer: **Arda Güler** , 19 years 114 days (vs Georgia, [EURO 2024](https://www.uefa.com/euro2024/match/2036171--turkiye-vs-georgia/))
### **Ukraine**
Youngest player: **Illia Zabarnyi** , 18 years 285 days (vs Netherlands, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024441--netherlands-vs-ukraine/))  
Youngest scorer: **Artem Dovbyk** , 24 years 8 days (vs Sweden, [EURO 2020](https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuro-2020/match/2024441--netherlands-vs-ukraine/))
